  userId: request.user?.username,
  title: target.title && Object.entries(target.title).map(([locale, value], index) => ({id: target.titleIds?.[index], locale, value})),
  body: target.body && Object.entries(target.body).map(([locale, value], index) => ({id: target.bodyIds?.[index], locale, value}))
}
format:
{
  ...target,
  title: Object.fromEntries(target.title.map(({locale, value}) => [locale, value])),
  titleIds: target.title.map(({id}) => id),
  body: Object.fromEntries(target.body.map(({locale, value}) => [locale, value])),
  bodyIds: target.body.map(({id}) => id)
}

components.name: Create
components.element:
<Create>
 <TabbedForm>
  <FormTab label="General">
   <TextInput source="id" validate={[required(), (({getOne}) => id => getOne('page', {id}).then(() => 'resources.validation.id', () => {}))(useDataProvider())]}/>
   <TranslatableInputs locales={Object.entries(settings.schema.locales).map(([name]) => name)}>
    <TextInput source="title"/>
    <Component schema="schema" name="CodeInput" source="body"/>
    <ImageInput multiple accept={{'image/*': []}} source="@files.body">
     <Component schema="page" name="ImageInput"/>
    </ImageInput>
   </TranslatableInputs>
  </FormTab>
  <FormTab label="Tags">
   <ArrayInput source="tags" label="">
    <SimpleFormIterator inline getItemLabel={() => ''}>
     <SelectInput source="name" choices={settings.page.tags.map(tag => ({id: tag, name: tag}))} validate={[required()]}/>
     <DateTimeInput source="start"/>
     <DateTimeInput source="end"/>
    </SimpleFormIterator>
   </ArrayInput>
  </FormTab>
 </TabbedForm>
</Create>

components.element: {((value, {setValue}, {selectedLocale}) => setValue(`body.${selectedLocale}`, (value ? (value[selectedLocale] ? value[selectedLocale] : '') : '') + ``)}/>)(useWatch({name: 'body'}), useFormContext(), useTranslatableContext())}

components.name: List
components.element:
{(locale => <List filters={[
 <TextInput source="id" alwaysOn/>,
 <Component schema="schema" name="ParseInput" component={TextInput} source="title" parse={value => `{value: Like('%${value}%')}`}/>,
 <Component schema="schema" name="ParseInput" component={SelectInput} source="tags" parse={value => `{name: '${value}'}`} choices={settings.page.tags.map(tag => ({id: tag, name: tag}))}/>
]} exporter={false}>
 <Datagrid rowClick={false}>
  <FunctionField source="id" render={({id}) =>
   <Link to={`/${id}`}>{id}</Link>
  }/>
  <TextField source={`title.${locale}`}/>
  <ArrayField source="tags">
   <SingleFieldList linkType={false}>
    <ChipField source="name" size="small"/>
   </SingleFieldList>
  </ArrayField>
  <EditButton/>
 </Datagrid>
</List>)(useLocale())}

components.name: Menu
components.element:
<Content resource="page" name="menu">
 {content =>
  <List>
   {content.map(({id, title}) =>
    <ListItem key={id}>
      <ListItemButton component={Link} to={`/${id}`}>
        <ListItemText primary={title}/>
      </ListItemButton>
    </ListItem>
   )}
  </List>
 }
</Content>

components.name: One
components.element:
<Content resource="page" name="one" id={props.id}>
 {({title, code}) =>
  (() => <Parser code={code}/>)(title && (document.title = title))
 }
</Content>
